messages:
Asha (PM): Quick sync: need a prioritization method for onboarding next quarter's models. Capacity is our gating factor; sales has two pilot asks.
Diego (ML Eng): Can we clarify capacity constraint: GPU count, VRAM, or endpoint slots?
Riley (Infra): Mostly GPU-hours and KV cache memory. Two dedicated pools; hosted has a small burst buffer. Roughly allows 2x 7-13B quant models or 1x 70B concurrently.
Priya (Prod Ops): Sales requests: pilot Mistral-style 8B for FinCo, and a compact embedder for search pilots.
Ben (Research): Embedding model could be high ROI if retrieval improves. LLM variants differ: some need tokenizer tweaks or new kernels.
Asha (PM): Proposal: apply RICE for ranking, then apply a feasibility "admit" filter: fits in pool without evicting canaries, quantizable, and minimal kernel churn.
Diego (ML Eng): Quick RICE example to sanity check:
Reach=10 pilot customers
Impact=3 (scale 1-5)
Confidence=0.6
Effort=8w
Score=(10*3*0.6)/8=2.25
But confidence is noisy for newer archs.
Priya (Prod Ops): Suggest a standard Launch Criteria checklist per candidate: perf >= baseline, token-cost <=1.2x, canary routing + fallback, docs + eval suite, KMS enabled for enterprise pilots.
Riley (Infra): Sequencing rule: prefer models that reuse existing kernel/codepaths and are quant-friendly to reduce infra ops.
Ben (Research): If embedder yields >5% recall@10 uplift, move it above other candidates — high customer impact.
Asha (PM): Action: score three candidates (mistral-8q, condensed-embed, llama-v3-13b) and then tag feasibility flags (capacity, quant compatibility, kernel-sharing). Can team post results by tomorrow EOD?
Diego (ML Eng): I'll bench memory & token latency today and post numbers with `#scorecard` tag.
Ben (Research): I'll run embedding evals and a small completions set for Llama-v3.
Riley (Infra): I'll run pool simulation for cp-8421 and mark headroom or reservation needs.
Priya (Prod Ops): I'll draft the Launch Criteria checklist and pilot gating items; will add Confluence link.
Diego (ML Eng): Bench summary posted: Mistral-8Q fits cp-8421, token cost ~0.78x vs our 13B baseline, p50 latency 18ms (was 22ms).
Ben (Research): Condensed embedder: +6.4% recall@10 in our internal evals, tokenizer tweak small but necessary.
Riley (Infra): Pool sim: cp-8421 ~12% headroom for canaries; larger rollout needs reserved nodes or autoscale bursts to hosted.
rollout-bot: canary-pool-create request accepted for pool cp-8421 (ID cp-8421)
Asha (PM): If RICE scores tie, tie-breaker = paying customer commitments > research curiosity. Friday sync to finalize order and rollout playbook. Tag artifacts with #scorecard. :thumbsup:
